name.value: Atlasphere ("we", "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of its users ("you"). This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our decentralized governance platform on Pi Network.

value.value: Atlasphere ("we", "our") is committed to protecting the privacy of its users ("you"). This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our decentralized governance platform on Pi Network.

name.value: Pi transactions are processed via the official Pi Network SDK. We record payment amounts and statuses to ensure transparency of community funding. We never store your private keys.

value.value: Pi transactions are processed via the official Pi Network SDK. We record payment amounts and statuses to ensure transparency of community funding. We never store your private keys.

name.value: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties. Votes and contributions are publicly visible on the platform to ensure governance transparency. Your Pi identifier may be shared with Pi Network for authentication.

value.value: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties. Votes and contributions are publicly visible on the platform to ensure governance transparency. Your Pi identifier may be shared with Pi Network for authentication.

name.value: We use reasonable security measures, including encryption in transit and secure Pi Network authentication.

value.value: We use reasonable security measures, including encryption in transit and secure Pi Network authentication.

name.value: You may request access, correction, export, or deletion of your personal data, subject to applicable law.

value.value: You may request access, correction, export, or deletion of your personal data, subject to applicable law.

name.value: Atlasphere uses local storage to save your language preferences and authentication session. No third-party tracking cookies are used.
